# open_white_carton — realism QA

Status: **provisional_B_not_certified**. Grades: evidence B, silhouette B, proportions B, colour_texture A, material B, articulation B, physics B, collision A, instances B, cross_view B. Primary visible IoU: 0.891.

Evidence: f3043, f3039, f3021. Camera intrinsics and metric transforms: `../review/calibration.json`. Comparison: `../review/open_white_carton_compare.jpg`. Per-frame dimensions, IoU, histogram and mask provenance: `../qa_report.json`.

Changes:
- Reduced excessive sleeve depth, rebuilt thin card walls and the bottom-hinged outward flap, and refit all three photographed silhouettes.
- Rebuilt physical mass estimates from constituent density and thin-shell/contact geometry; updated part COM, affine instance mass and material-specific friction.
- Rebuilt reproducible Blender/GLB meshes and collision geometry; preserved instance and review metadata in standalone rebuilds.
- Allocated independent UV atlas tiles to all sleeve/flap panels and baked the photographed interior.

Remaining:
- Mass, contents, friction, restitution and hidden wall thickness are unmeasured priors.
- Static visible-state evidence does not verify actuation force, thread pitch, seal behavior or fracture. Closed-retention constraints require explicit release actions in a runtime importer.
